entities.name: Jiří Kochta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Kochta was a Czech professional ice hockey player who played in the Czechoslovak Extraliga. He played for HC Jihlava and HC Sparta Praha. He won a silver medal at the 1968 Winter Olympics and a bronze medal at the 1972 Winter Olympics.
